newsitem.title: USA: Weingarten sees "very positive" FFO outlook.
newsitem.headline: Weingarten sees "very positive" FFO outlook.

text.p: Weingarten Realty Investors said Friday its outlook is "very positive" for continued growth in the company's funds from operations.

Stanford Alexander, chairman and chief executive officer, said the real investment trust's outlook is a result of improved performance from the existing portfolio and the acquisition and new development programs.
Funds from operations or FFO is net income plus depreciation and amortization less gain on sales.
The company said that its FFO for the second quarter ended June 30 rose 9.2 percent to $22.0 million or $0.83 per share compared with $20.1 million or $0.76 per share, over the same period last year.
For the first six months of 1997, it said its FFO rose 8.6 percent to $44.0 million or $1.65 per share, over the same period in 1996.
